title: Register Read
text: Read data from a register region on the specified IP core, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Data type used by IP core; {Device name} sets the path and file name of IP core device, {Offset address} sets the offset from the base address of the IP core to the register, {Output vector size} sets the size of data vector from IP core and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device name
params.values: Path and file name of IP core device /dev/mwipcore (default) | character array

params.name: Offset address
params.values: Offset from the base address of the IP core to the register hex2dec(’0100’) (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type used by IP core uint32 (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean | fixed-point

params.name: Output vector size
params.values: Size of data vector from IP core 1 (default) | positive integer
